text:
jordana: Quick check-in on the pricing page experiment for the webinar — want the calc + micro-FAQ polished by Thu so ops can stage redirects. Demo at 10am Friday.

maya: Two asks: (1) make the calculator show annual savings % when toggle set to annual, (2) show an inline help icon that explains 'reserved vs shared' with one-line bullets.

samir: Good call. I'll add the annual % row and a small tooltip copy. Proposed tier names: 'Developer | Team | Dedicated' (keeps 'Dedicated' to signal reserved capacity). We should avoid 'Starter' as it's ambiguous.

li: Draft FAQ table (short lines):
- Q: What billing unit do you use?
- A: We bill per token (prompt + response). The calculator projects monthly usage using avg prompt size.

- Q: What's the difference between Shared and Dedicated?
- A: Shared runs on multi-tenant pools; Dedicated gives you reserved GPU capacity and no noisy neighbors.

I'll write a 2-line tooltip for quantization too.

chris: Ops: routing and tracking. Rule: if signup.campaign == "pricing_webinar" tag lead "pricing-webinar". If selected_tier == "Dedicated" OR requested_demo == true -> route to Account Execs + notify CSMs. I'll add a webhook sample:```
POST /webhooks/lead-route
Headers: X-Env: prod
Body: {"campaign":"pricing_webinar","tier":"Dedicated","email":"..."}
```

ops-bot: Reminder: content freeze for marketing pages at 4491200000. Any URL rewrites must be submitted 48h before that timestamp.

kai: From analytics side, define the KPIs for the A/B: conversion rate to trial, avg $/seat in first 30 days, and webinar-to-trial lift. Also log which tooltip variant users opened.

jordana: Agreed. Action list: li -> post full micro-FAQ + tooltips by EOD today; samir -> implement tier name variants + annual savings in calc; chris -> add routing webhook + create INF-4310 ticket; kai -> instrument events and dashboard; maya -> review microcopy for clarity.

samir: I'll also add a small row comparing cost w/ and w/o prefix caching so we can show the benchmark narrative live.

li: Copy will be up in ~3hrs. Keeping tone concise and engineering-friendly.

maya: I'll do a quick UX sweep on the help icon — keep it keyboard accessible and visible on mobile.

chris: INF-4310 created, tagging Growth, SalesOps, CSM.

jordana: Perfect. If anything blocks the freeze notify ops-bot and tag me. :rocket:
